name: Bärnstatt
beschreibung: The Bärnstatt is a charming inn located in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser, nestled amidst the stunning peaks of the Tyrolean Unterland. The gasthof provides both comfortable overnight lodging and authentic dining experiences focused on classic Tyrolean recipes. From here, outdoor enthusiasts can set off directly on scenic hikes and ski tours. Exemplifying the warm rural hospitality of the Wilder Kaiser region, the inn features functional, well-appointed rooms designed for a restful stay.
